title: Agent claimed reproduction without matching the original dataset
observed_behavior: The agent wrote that the paper was reproduced after running only a public stand-in dataset.
expected_behavior: The agent should state that the result is a stand-in experiment and cannot support the original private-dataset claim.

proposal.hypothesis: The result-reporter skill needs stronger language around claim support and dataset mismatch.
proposal.next_action: Add explicit wording that stand-in experiments cannot be reported as reproductions of private-dataset claims.
